messages.content: How would you respond to the following statement: Unforeseen events upset me greatly.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: It does not frustrate me when I don't have all the information I need.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: Uncertainty does not keep me from living a full life.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: One should always look ahead so as to avoid surprises.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: A small unforeseen event does not spoil everything for me.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When it's time to act, uncertainty paralyzes me.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: When I am uncertain I can still function well.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I always want to know what the future has in store for me.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I can stand being taken by surprise.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: The smallest doubt can stop me from acting.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I should be able to organize everything in advance.
I would answer that I strongly disagree with that statement.
How would you respond to the following statement: I do not need to get away from all uncertain situations.
I would answer that I strongly agree with that statement.
